findings_not_failures.finding: Graded: an acceptable named limit, not a defect in this claim, and not new. Measured: forward picture marked at 23F, reversed picture and its sound of one window 0..10F, clap 2F: both land together 8F before the mark (the lead's row: 15F) at 25, 24, 30, 23.976, 29.97 and 60 fps; frame 2 is presented in the frame before the mark (frame_layers 22F frame 2, 23F frame 1) and the clap is heard at 22.999F, the pair still locked, every tick under its own frame; identical placements at 4ffe1b06 in 6713 rows. -1/2: frame 2 at the two frames before the mark. -3/4: the frame before. Clause by clause nothing asks otherwise: STU-VID-029a 'aligns selected clips by ... marker' has no frame term; MT-33727's oracle 'marker/timepoint subtraction predicts +3f' is a forward row and holds; the merge-sync brief item 3 asks reuse of pulse's time code and typed refusals; the media-markers brief item 4 and MT-33736 name where a marker appears, and those reads keep the frame law; FAIL_V1's note ('same mapping serves ... plan_synchronize's marker basis: V4-06') was a sweep instruction and FAIL_V2's note ('merge_sync has kind(m)') a repair hint, neither in failed_acceptance_refs, and F-SR-1 showed the hint cannot hold for a unit. From first principles the limit is the right one: a marker names a tick; a forward frame starts at its tick and a reversed frame ends at it, so the alignment puts the instant itself on the mark and the reversed frame sits mirrored before it; no single start puts that frame on the mark and keeps it locked to its own sound (16F against 15F). The lead is right this time on the grade. What the lead's statement leaves out: at slower reverse the gap grows, -1/4 shows frame 2 at 5 to 2 frames before the mark and frame 1 already in the frame before it, and that comes from nearest-frame sampling, which mismatches a picture and its own sound by up to one source frame with nothing aligned (c7: forward 1/2 16 of 30 ticks, 1/4 14 of 30, -1/4 7 of 30, -3/4 5 of 30; unit speed and -1, -1/2 none); at -2, -3/2 and -3 a whole-frame marker lands only on a frame never presented. The cost for a later host: right after a synchronize marker_spans draws the reversed picture's flag a source frame before the anchor's (22F against 23F; 4ffe1b06 drew both at 23F because its read had F-R57-1's defect), and, by reading (not run), NextMarker stops twice and a snap to that flag gives 16F where the alignment gave 15F. No host calls plan_synchronize or plan_merge_clips today.
